title: Keurig K Supreme Smart Single Serve Coffee Maker, Multistream (Black) | Brewid and Multistream Tech, WI-FI App Control, Brews 6-12 Oz, 66 Oz Removable Reservoir, Black
features: BrewID: WiFi enabled BrewID technology, recognizes your specific K-Cup pod and customizes brew settings. BrewID technology will recommend SIGNATURE BREW settings created by the coffee experts for the most flavorful brew.
COMPLETE CUSTOMIZATION: Personalize your cup with five strength settings (from Balanced to Intense) and six temperature settings (from Warm to Max Hot).
MULTISTREAM TECHNOLOGY: Saturates the grounds more evenly to extract full flavor and aroma (vs. leading Keurig K-Classic brewer).
BREW OVER ICE: Brew hot over ice for full-flavored, delicious iced coffee.

WiFi & APP COMPATIBLE: Connecting your K-Supreme SMART to WiFi via the Keurig app allows you to brew from anywhere, schedule a brew, customize your brew settings, and create and save favorite settings via the Keurig app. It also enables you to manage your SMART Delivery via the app, so you never run out of your favorite K-Cup pods.
VOICE ASSIST: Add Keurig to your morning routing using Voice Assist (Amazon Alexa or Google Home) to brew your coffee.
CUSTOM FAVORITE SETTINGS: Save up to 10 custom settings, so it’s easier than ever for everyone in the household to enjoy their favorite cup.
66 OZ DUAL-POSITION RESERVOIR: Allows you to brew up to nine cups before refilling.
BACK-TO-BACK BREWING: Immediately brew a second cup; no need to wait for reheating.
